SPARQL:
PREFIX ex: <http://thesis.ulukbek.eu/ontology#>
SELECT ?assembly ?material ?topology ?family
WHERE {
    ?assembly rdf:type ?family .
    ?assembly ex:hasMaterial ex:Steel .
    ?assembly ex:hasTopology ex:Sparse .
    ?assembly ex:belongsToFamily ?fam .
    BIND(ex:Steel AS ?material)
    BIND(ex:Sparse AS ?topology)
    FILTER(?assembly != ex:21448_5646a1b6)
}
LIMIT 10

PREFIX ex: <http://thesis.ulukbek.eu/ontology#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?family (COUNT(?assembly) AS ?count)
WHERE {
    ?familyClass rdfs:subClassOf ex:EngineeringAssembly .
    ?assembly rdf:type ?familyClass .
    BIND(STR(?familyClass) AS ?family)
}
GROUP BY ?family
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX ex: <http://thesis.ulukbek.eu/ontology#>
SELECT ?assembly ?complexity ?structure
WHERE {
    ?assembly ex:hasComplexityLevel ex:Low .
    ?assembly ex:hasStructure ex:Symmetric .
    FILTER(?assembly != ex:21448_5646a1b6)
}
LIMIT 5
